_comment: Frozen contract for a theme someone (or an agent) brings themselves, and the built-in themes it sits beside.
The colors are the app's own tokens, as hex. `required` must all be given, `optional` may be, and
nothing else is accepted. `translucent` colors may carry alpha (#rrggbbaa); every other one is solid
(#rgb or #rrggbb). Its id is `custom-` and its name lowercased with every run of other characters as
Two copies read it: the app's parser (mycelium-frontend/src/lib/custom-themes.ts, which also checks
contrast and shows the problems, and which the app's own server uses on the theme files) and the
CLI's (mycelium-cli/src/mycelium/themes.py, which writes ~/.mycelium/themes/ and refuses a file the
app would refuse). `builtin` is every theme the app ships, by id (mycelium-frontend/src/lib/themes.ts),
which is what `mycelium theme use` may name besides a custom one, along with `system`. Each side's
